promise: Apple will spend more than $30 billion with Broadcom, producing at least 15 billion U.S.-made chips through 2031
description: Apple announced a multiyear agreement with Broadcom expected to exceed $30 billion and result in the production of more than 15 billion U.S.-made chips, including expansion of Broadcom's Fort Collins, Colorado facility. Broadcom disclosed the long-term supply deal runs through 2031.

promise: Invest $10 billion in Micron Research Labs, a U.S.-based long-horizon innovation hub for memory and AI
description: Micron announced on August 20, 2026 a $10 billion investment in Micron Research Labs, a U.S.-based long-horizon innovation hub in Boise, Idaho, to shape the future of memory and AI, adding to its U.S. manufacturing push. No completion deadline was disclosed; end of 2031 is used as a review horizon.
evidence: Micron press release August 20, 2026 announcing the $10 billion research investment
Boise-based research hub; part of Micron's broader U.S. manufacturing expansion

role: IT services subsidiary of Samsung Group
promise: Invest 10 trillion won ($7.4 billion) by 2031 in AI infrastructure, robotics and acquisitions
description: Samsung SDS CEO Lee June-hee said at REAL Summit 2026 in Seoul that the company plans to invest 10 trillion won ($7.4 billion) by 2031 to expand AI infrastructure and pursue robotics investments and acquisitions, with the United States a key robot market.
evidence: Announced by CEO Lee June-hee at REAL Summit 2026 on September 8, 2026
